items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: Formal service (förmliche Zustellung per Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) is documented on page 2 as having occurred on 23.11.2026 (Monday) — the deliverer entered this date on the Zustellungsurkunde. Since this is formal service, the statutory deemed-delivery rule for ordinary mail does not apply; the actual service date (23.11.2026) is the anchor. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the 2-week objection period starts on 24.11.2026. Counting two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) ends on 07.12.2026 (Monday). This date is a normal business day in Niedersachsen (no weekend/holiday shift needed), so the Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag) after the decision becomes final
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: The Bußgeldbescheid becomes final (Rechtskraft) only if no Einspruch is filed within the 2-week objection period, which ends 07.12.2026 (see the Einspruch item). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft enters on 08.12.2026, the day after the objection period expires. The payment period of 'zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft' then starts counting the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. from 08.12.2026, and two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) falls on 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), a normal business day, so no shift is needed. This due date applies only if the person does not lodge an Einspruch; if they do, the Bescheid is not final and this payment obligation does not (yet) arise.

warnings: The letter states the Zustellung (formal service) date as 23.11.2026 on a separately attached Zustellungsurkunde copy on page 2, handwritten and only initialed ('Jan.') — if the actual envelope/original differs, the Einspruch and payment deadlines must be recalculated from the true service date.
The payment deadline of 22.12.2026 only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; filing an Einspruch suspends the Rechtskraft and this payment obligation.

The paragraph about the telephone hotline being unreachable on 11.12.2026 introduces a different reference code ('RK-8213-958') for written enquiries that does not match the official Aktenzeichen (BG 32.2-26/40918) printed elsewhere on the letter — this mismatch is unusual and should be verified with the Bußgeldstelle directly before using that code in any correspondence.
The IBAN given (DE17 2805 0100 0002 6655 00) is a valid, well-formed German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership; compare it against any earlier official correspondence before paying.
